release_notes:
Newsletter formatting freedom + CKEditor upgrade to 4.22.1

Two improvements to newsletter and content editing:

- Newsletter bodies are now sent exactly as authored. The send paths no longer inject inline styles or a centered wrapper into the content — lists render normally (bullets with their text) and whatever formatting the admin composes in the newsletter editor takes effect as-is.
- The admin rich-text editor (used across all editor pages: newsletters, news, pages, service descriptions, email templates, products, FAQs and more) is upgraded from CKEditor 4.12.1 to 4.22.1, the last open-source 4.x release, picking up the published 4.x XSS security fixes. The emojione plugin and editor configuration carry over; the obsolete flash and wsc plugins were removed upstream by CKEditor and are unused by the app.
